```c
// AUTO-GENERATED optimized MX attention kernel (S=128, D=64) with host-accelerator pipelining
void solution(void) {
  const int tiles_S = ATT_S / DIM;  // 128/16 = 8
  const int tiles_D = ATT_D / DIM;  // 64/16 = 4
  const int tiles_K_QKT = tiles_D;  // Q[128][64] x KT[64][128]
  const int tiles_K_PV = tiles_S;   // P[128][128] x V[128][64]

  // ---- Scratchpad Layout ----
  // Double-buffer Q tiles: Buffer0 [0..63], Buffer1 [64..127]
  const uint32_t a_base_0 = 0;
  const uint32_t a_base_1 = 64;
  // KT is stationary at top of scratchpad
  const uint32_t b_base_kt = BANK_NUM * BANK_ROWS - tiles_K_QKT * tiles_S * DIM; // 8192 - 4*8*16 = 7680
  // P tiles double-buffered similarly
  const uint32_t a_base_p0 = 0;
  const uint32_t a_base_p1 = 64;
  // V is stationary
  const uint32_t b_base_v = BANK_NUM * BANK_ROWS - tiles_K_PV * tiles_D * DIM; // 8192 - 8*4*16 = 7680

  // ---- 1) S1 = Q @ K^T (Pipelined per 16-row tile of Q) ----
  // Pre-load stationary KT weights and their scales once
  gemmini_flush(0);
  gemmini_extended3_config_ex(WEIGHT_STATIONARY, 0, 0, ACC_SCALE_IDENTITY, 1, 1, 0, 0, false, 0, 0, 3, 0);
  gemmini_mx_load_scales((uint64_t)&KT_scales_col, sizeof(KT_scales_col), 1); // Weights (B)
  gemmini_config_ld(ATT_S * sizeof(elem_t)); // Stride for KT_in
  for (int k = 0; k < tiles_K_QKT; k++) {
    for (int j = 0; j < tiles_S; j += MAX_BLOCK_LEN) {
      int len = (tiles_S - j < MAX_BLOCK_LEN) ? (tiles_S - j) : MAX_BLOCK_LEN;
      gemmini_extended_mvin(
          (void *)(((elem_t *)KT_in) + (k * DIM) * ATT_S + j * DIM),
          b_base_kt + (k * tiles_S + j) * DIM,
          len * DIM, DIM);
    }
  }
  gemmini_fence(); // Ensure KT is fully loaded before starting pipeline

  // Pre-load Q scale factors
  gemmini_mx_load_scales((uint64_t)&Q_scales_row, sizeof(Q_scales_row), 0); // Activations (A)

  for (int i = 0; i < tiles_S; i++) {
    // Load Q tile i into alternating buffer
    uint32_t a_curr_base = (i % 2 == 0) ? a_base_0 : a_base_1;
    gemmini_config_ld(ATT_D * sizeof(elem_t)); // Stride for Q_in
    for (int k = 0; k < tiles_K_QKT; k += MAX_BLOCK_LEN) {
      int len = (tiles_K_QKT - k < MAX_BLOCK_LEN) ? (tiles_K_QKT - k) : MAX_BLOCK_LEN;
      gemmini_extended_mvin(
          (void *)(((elem_t *)Q_in) + (i * DIM) * ATT_D + k * DIM),
          a_curr_base + k * DIM,
          len * DIM, DIM);
    }

    // Compute S1[i, :]
    gemmini_loop_ws_spad(1, tiles_S, tiles_K_QKT, 0, 0, 0,
                         a_curr_base, BANK_NUM * BANK_ROWS, 0, SPAD_DEST,
                         false, false, false, false, false, NO_ACTIVATION, 0, 0, false, 0x38);

    // Drain previous S1 tile (i-1) if not first iteration
    if (i > 0) {
      int prev_i = i - 1;
      gemmini_mx_read_smem(&S1_hw[prev_i][0], SPAD_DEST * 16, DIM * ATT_S);
      gemmini_fence();

      // --- CPU Softmax on S1[prev_i, :] ---
      int64_t q[ATT_S];
      int64_t mq = -((int64_t)1 << 62);
      for (int j = 0; j < ATT_S; j += 4) {
        uint64_t w = S1_hw[prev_i][j / 4];
        uint16_t ch0 = (uint16_t)(w & 0xFFFF);
        uint16_t ch1 = (uint16_t)((w >> 16) & 0xFFFF);
        uint16_t ch2 = (uint16_t)((w >> 32) & 0xFFFF);
        uint16_t ch3 = (uint16_t)(w >> 48);
#if ATT_CAUSAL
        int64_t qq0 = (j + 0 <= prev_i) ? mx_ibf16_to_q(ch0) : -((int64_t)1 << 62);
        int64_t qq1 = (j + 1 <= prev_i) ? mx_ibf16_to_q(ch1) : -((int64_t)1 << 62);
        int64_t qq2 = (j + 2 <= prev_i) ? mx_ibf16_to_q(ch2) : -((int64_t)1 << 62);
        int64_t qq3 = (j + 3 <= prev_i) ? mx_ibf16_to_q(ch3) : -((int64_t)1 << 62);
#else
        int64_t qq0 = mx_ibf16_to_q(ch0);
        int64_t qq1 = mx_ibf16_to_q(ch1);
        int64_t qq2 = mx_ibf16_to_q(ch2);
        int64_t qq3 = mx_ibf16_to_q(ch3);
#endif
        q[j+0]=qq0; q[j+1]=qq1; q[j+2]=qq2; q[j+3]=qq3;
        if (qq0 > mq) mq = qq0;
        if (qq1 > mq) mq = qq1;
        if (qq2 > mq) mq = qq2;
        if (qq3 > mq) mq = qq3;
      }

      int64_t p[ATT_S];
      int64_t sm = 0;
      int64_t gmax_arr[GROUPS_S];
      for (int g = 0; g < GROUPS_S; g++) {
        int64_t gmax = 0;
        for (int jj = g * 32; jj < (g + 1) * 32; jj++) {
          int64_t pv = mx_iexp(q[jj] - mq);
          p[jj] = pv; sm += pv;
          if (pv > gmax) gmax = pv;
        }
        gmax_arr[g] = gmax;
      }
      int ls = mx_ilog2((uint64_t)sm);
      uint64_t inv_sm = (((uint64_t)1 << (ls + MX_FRAC)) + ((uint64_t)sm >> 1)) / (uint64_t)sm;
      for (int g = 0; g < GROUPS_S; g++) {
        int64_t gmax = gmax_arr[g];
        if (gmax == 0) {
          P_scales[g][prev_i] = 0;
          for (int jj = g * 32; jj < (g + 1) * 32; jj++) P_q[prev_i][jj] = 0;
          continue;
        }
        int e = mx_ilog2((uint64_t)gmax) - ls - MX_P_TARGET_LOG2;
        P_scales[g][prev_i] = (uint8_t)(e + 127);
        for (int jj = g * 32; jj < (g + 1) * 32; jj++)
          P_q[prev_i][jj] = mx_ienc_fp8(p[jj], inv_sm, ls, e);
      }
    }
  }

  // Handle final tile (i = tiles_S-1)
  gemmini_mx_read_smem(&S1_hw[tiles_S - 1][0], SPAD_DEST * 16, DIM * ATT_S);
  gemmini_fence();

  int prev_i = tiles_S - 1;
  int64_t q[ATT_S];
  int64_t mq = -((int64_t)1 << 62);
  for (int j = 0; j < ATT_S; j += 4) {
    uint64_t w = S1_hw[prev_i][j / 4];
    uint16_t ch0 = (uint16_t)(w & 0xFFFF);
    uint16_t ch1 = (uint16_t)((w >> 16) & 0xFFFF);
    uint16_t ch2 = (uint16_t)((w >> 32) & 0xFFFF);
    uint16_t ch3 = (uint16_t)(w >> 48);
#if ATT_CAUSAL
    int64_t qq0 = (j + 0 <= prev_i) ? mx_ibf16_to_q(ch0) : -((int64_t)1 << 62);
    int64_t qq1 = (j + 1 <= prev_i) ? mx_ibf16_to_q(ch1) : -((int64_t)1 << 62);
    int64_t qq2 = (j + 2 <= prev_i) ? mx_ibf16_to_q(ch2) : -((int64_t)1 << 62);
    int64_t qq3 = (j + 3 <= prev_i) ? mx_ibf16_to_q(ch3) : -((int64_t)1 << 62);
#else
    int64_t qq0 = mx_ibf16_to_q(ch0);
    int64_t qq1 = mx_ibf16_to_q(ch1);
    int64_t qq2 = mx_ibf16_to_q(ch2);
    int64_t qq3 = mx_ibf16_to_q(ch3);
#endif
    q[j+0]=qq0; q[j+1]=qq1; q[j+2]=qq2; q[j+3]=qq3;
    if (qq0 > mq) mq = qq0;
    if (qq1 > mq) mq = qq1;
    if (qq2 > mq) mq = qq2;
    if (qq3 > mq) mq = qq3;
  }

  int64_t p[ATT_S];
  int64_t sm = 0;
  int64_t gmax_arr[GROUPS_S];
  for (int g = 0; g < GROUPS_S; g++) {
    int64_t gmax = 0;
    for (int jj = g * 32; jj < (g + 1) * 32; jj++) {
      int64_t pv = mx_iexp(q[jj] - mq);
      p[jj] = pv; sm += pv;
      if (pv > gmax) gmax = pv;
    }
    gmax_arr[g] = gmax;
  }
  int ls = mx_ilog2((uint64_t)sm);
  uint64_t inv_sm = (((uint64_t)1 << (ls + MX_FRAC)) + ((uint64_t)sm >> 1)) / (uint64_t)sm;
  for (int g = 0; g < GROUPS_S; g++) {
    int64_t gmax = gmax_arr[g];
    if (gmax == 0) {
      P_scales[g][prev_i] = 0;
      for (int jj = g * 32; jj < (g + 1) * 32; jj++) P_q[prev_i][jj] = 0;
      continue;
    }
    int e = mx_ilog2((uint64_t)gmax) - ls - MX_P_TARGET_LOG2;
    P_scales[g][prev_i] = (uint8_t)(e + 127);
    for (int jj = g * 32; jj < (g + 1) * 32; jj++)
      P_q[prev_i][jj] = mx_ienc_fp8(p[jj], inv_sm, ls, e);
  }


  // ---- 3) O = P @ V (Pipelined per 16-row tile of P) ----
  // Pre-load stationary V weights and their scales once
  gemmini_flush(0);
  gemmini_extended3_config_ex(WEIGHT_STATIONARY, 0, 0, ACC_SCALE_IDENTITY, 1, 1, 0, 0, false, 0, 0, 3, 0);
  gemmini_mx_load_scales((uint64_t)&V_scales_col, sizeof(V_scales_col), 1); // Weights (B)
  gemmini_config_ld(ATT_D * sizeof(elem_t)); // Stride for V_in
  for (int k = 0; k < tiles_K_PV; k++) {
    for (int j = 0; j < tiles_D; j += MAX_BLOCK_LEN) {
      int len = (tiles_D - j < MAX_BLOCK_LEN) ? (tiles_D - j) : MAX_BLOCK_LEN;
      gemmini_extended_mvin(
          (void *)(((elem_t *)V_in) + (k * DIM) * ATT_D + j * DIM),
          b_base_v + (k * tiles_D + j) * DIM,
          len * DIM, DIM);
    }
  }
  gemmini_fence(); // Ensure V is fully loaded before starting pipeline

  // Pre-load P scale factors
  gemmini_mx_load_scales((uint64_t)&P_scales, sizeof(P_scales), 0); // Activations (A)

  for (int i = 0; i < tiles_S; i++) {
    // Load P tile i into alternating buffer
    uint32_t a_curr_base = (i % 2 == 0) ? a_base_p0 : a_base_p1;
    gemmini_config_ld(ATT_S * sizeof(elem_t)); // Stride for P_q
    for (int k = 0; k < tiles_K_PV; k += MAX_BLOCK_LEN) {
      int len = (tiles_K_PV - k < MAX_BLOCK_LEN) ? (tiles_K_PV - k) : MAX_BLOCK_LEN;
      gemmini_extended_mvin(
          (void *)(((elem_t *)P_q) + (i * DIM) * ATT_S + k * DIM),
          a_curr_base + k * DIM,
          len * DIM, DIM);
    }

    // Compute O[i, :]
    gemmini_loop_ws_spad(1, tiles_D, tiles_K_PV, 0, 0, 0,
                         a_curr_base, BANK_NUM * BANK_ROWS, 0, SPAD_DEST,
                         false, false, false, false, false, NO_ACTIVATION, 0, 0, false, 0x38);

    // Drain O[i, :] immediately
    gemmini_mx_read_smem(&O_hw[i][0], SPAD_DEST * 16, DIM * ATT_D);
    gemmini_fence();
  }
}
```
